// the frame origin lies on the curve and its Z axis is tangent. The basis for
// sweeps, lofts, and camera paths
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frenet%E2%80%93Serret_formulas).
interface IFramedCurve3D
    inherits IDifferentiableCurve3D
{
    FrameAt(x: Self, t: Number): Frame3D;
}
